name: Tenderize V2
rootCause: Tenderize V2 is catalogued as suffering a logic-related incident on Ethereum Mainnet on April 7, 2025, with an estimated loss of $10,850. No technical exploit details, root cause, affected contract, or recovery evidence are publicly documented. The incident is classified in aggregator catalogues as a protocol logic error affecting Tenderize V2. No technical details, affected contract addresses, attack vector, or vulnerable code have been identified or publicly disclosed.
